name: corpus
description: Connect exact sources and build reusable corpus context.

interface.shortDescription: Explore sources and reuse corpus context
interface.longDescription: Corpus connects registered folders and bounded provider records for work, research, and personal collections. It inventories files, selectively prepares searchable text and stable source locations, and lets the agent build reusable context from exact file, mail, or completed agent-task sources. Gmail content remains with its connector, while completed Codex and Claude turns are read from their original provider records only when requested. The personal view retains full source links, while an optional general view can be prepared for external reuse. Registered documents and provider state remain unchanged. Archived contexts remain readable; destructive context purge is not provided.
